title: One Hundred Years of Solitude
author: Gabriel García Márquez
description: A novel that tells the story of the Buendía family over seven generations in the fictional town of Macondo.

author: George Orwell
description: A dystopia that portrays a totalitarian future where the government controls every aspect of people's lives.

title: The Hobbit
author: J.R.R. Tolkien
description: The adventure of Bilbo Baggins, who embarks on an unexpected journey to help a group of dwarves recover their treasure.

title: Pride and Prejudice
author: Jane Austen
description: The story of Elizabeth Bennet and her complicated relationship with the proud Mr. Darcy in 19th century England.

title: Don Quixote
author: Miguel de Cervantes
description: The adventures of a nobleman who loses his sanity by reading too many chivalry books and decides to become a knight-errant.

title: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone
author: J.K. Rowling
description: Harry Potter's first year at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry, where he discovers his true identity and faces unexpected dangers.

title: To Kill a Mockingbird
author: Harper Lee
description: A story about justice and racial injustice in the southern United States during the 1930s, told through the eyes of a young girl.

title: The Great Gatsby
author: F. Scott Fitzgerald
description: A novel that explores the excesses of the Jazz Age in America through the story of the enigmatic millionaire Jay Gatsby.

title: Crime and Punishment
author: Fyodor Dostoevsky
description: The story of Raskolnikov, a student who commits murder and struggles with its psychological consequences.

title: The Name of the Wind
author: Patrick Rothfuss
description: First part of The Kingkiller Chronicle, it tells the story of the legendary wizard Kvothe in his own words.

title: Sapiens: A Brief History of Humankind
author: Yuval Noah Harari
description: A journey through human history, from the emergence of Homo sapiens to the present day and beyond.

title: Dune
author: Frank Herbert
description: A science fiction epic set in a distant future that follows the struggle for control of the desert planet Arrakis.

title: Blindness
author: José Saramago
description: An epidemic of blindness ravages a city and reveals the best and worst of human nature.

title: Les Misérables
author: Victor Hugo
description: The epic story of Jean Valjean, a former convict seeking redemption in 19th century France, amid revolutions and social struggles.

title: Animal Farm
author: George Orwell
description: A political satire in the form of a fable that relates the revolution of farm animals against their human owners, and their subsequent drift toward tyranny.

title: The Shadow of the Wind
author: Carlos Ruiz Zafón
description: In post-war Barcelona, young Daniel Sempere discovers a cursed book that will change the course of his life as he tries to unravel the mysteries surrounding its author.
